answer: Timed hardware attestation quorum. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge within a narrow hardware-timing window, and valid responses require a physical pulse signature from a registered device. Enrollment demands one verified unit of copper-verified sensor calibration per identity, so each fake account consumes scarce, serialized calibration throughput rather than money. An attacker scaling to N identities must procure and time-sync N distinct calibrated devices, and any botnet sharing one timing source collapses to a single orchard of correlated failures that the quorum rejects.
